cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Enjoy your afternoon off. Your bike will be ready for tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's the repair shop asking me to collect a wheel?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. They've got your number on the ticket. I'll collect everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A wheel? Is the rest at another shop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only until four. Stay with your book; I've planned a route that gets all of it home before you need it.

mechanism: A uses precise collection and repair coordination to hide a fragmented bike problem from B, claiming sole professional control to preserve B afternoon off.
confusable: Ordinary efficient errands could be shared transparently; A deliberately minimises the problem because B should not have to spend free time on it.
comparison: Leak alternative protects sleep through rearranged rest; bike alternative shields leisure through coordinated parts collection.
seedUse: Wheel at one shop, other parts and book derive from D39-b; S03 adds clear distinction between collection contact and repair responsibility.
